## ⚡ Quick Run

```bash
chmod +x Zalo-*.AppImage && ./Zalo-*.AppImage
```

## 📦 Assets Guide

- **Architecture**:
  - `x86_64`: Intel / AMD (64-bit)
  - `aarch64`: ARM64 (Raspberry Pi, Asahi Linux, etc.)
- **Variants**:
  - `Original`: Standard interface.
  - `+ZaDark`: Pre-integrated dark mode, custom fonts, and privacy protections.
- **Delta Updates**: `.AppImage.zsync` files are metadata for delta updaters (e.g. `AM`, `AppImageUpdate`). Download `.AppImage` directly for manual execution.

## 📖 Documentation & Support

- **Quick Start & Desktop Integration**: [README.md](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux#quick-start) | [Tiếng Việt](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/blob/main/docs/user/README.vi.md)
- **Troubleshooting & Known Issues**: [Troubleshooting Guide](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/blob/main/docs/user/known-issues.md) | [Tiếng Việt](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/blob/main/docs/user/known-issues.vi.md)
- **Bug Reports & Feedback**: [Open an Issue](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/issues)

---

## What's Changed

### Features

* feat(rust): lint clippy, safe abstractions, and audit gating by @ngxccc in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/231
* feat(zadark): support Flatpak extension mount path and dynamic asset injection by @ngxccc in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/221
* feat(i18n): add centralized language bridge and multilingual plugin support by @DMKha241 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/214
* feat(build): trim non-Linux addon junk and unused Electron locales by @ngxccc in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/213
* feat: add dedicated Developer Mode plugin by @DMKha241 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/209
* feat(plugins): keep recalled messages (off by default) by @nguyenphivn in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/196
* feat(zcall-audio): implement native rust low-latency audio engine by @ngxccc in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/180
* feat: add native screenshot tool by @akimiya7742 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/178
* feat(nativelibs): Clean room RE và tích hợp lại addon os-sys-info (dùng để lấy thông tin kiến trúc os và pid) by @imngkhang in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/192
* feat(zlang): implement native rust language detection engine by @ngxccc in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/184
* feat(nativelibs)-license-docs(readme,architecture,nativelibs): Thêm zfile, zwalker, v8-profiles, đổi license sang BSD 3-Clause, và update lại các file docs by @imngkhang in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/172
* feat(zadark): add two-way theme synchronization between ZaDark and Zalo by @DMKha241 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/162
* feat(tray): show unread count badge on the tray icon by @namtao in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/151

### Fixes

* fix(linux): stop shell.openPath() from freezing the UI thread by @ebylxn in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/223
* fix(build): fetch ONNX Runtime from NuGet after GitHub release removal by @VN-Linux-Family in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/232
* fix(zcall): fix audio clipping, auto mic gain, playout sync, and network handover by @ngxccc in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/220
* fix(calls): send-rate fallback ladder filtered on a field it does not have by @vupn0712 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/225
* fix(calls): ping server trong lúc đổ chuông by @vupn0712 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/227
* fix(app): fix auto theme by @lolmc0587 in https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/pull/216
* fix: asar load on electron 22, true arch install, allow empty disk list in flatpak and zfile i

**English** | [Tiếng Việt](./docs/user/README.vi.md)

Zalo for Linux 🐧

[![Build Status](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/actions/workflows/build.yml) [![All Contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/all-contributors/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux?color=ee8449&style=flat-square)](#contributors) An unofficial, community-driven port of the Zalo desktop application for **Linux only**, created by repackaging the official macOS client into a standard AppImage with integrated ZaDark. Thanks **realdtn2** for the solution: [realdtn2/zalo-linux-2026](https://github.com/DMKha241/zalo-linux-2026) (original repo is deleted/hidden, we are using a backup repo from [DMKha241](https://github.com/DMKha241)). ## ⚡ Quick Start ### 1. AM Install and update directly using [AM](https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM) (for a graphical interface, install [AM-GUI](https://github.com/Shikakiben/AM-GUI)): ```bash # Install Zalo am -i zalo # Update Zalo am -u ```

--- ### 2. Nix The repository provides a Nix flake packaging the release AppImage with call dependencies: **NixOS Configuration (`flake.nix` + `configuration.nix`):** ```nix # flake.nix { inputs.zalo-for-linux = { url = "github:VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux"; inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs"; }; outputs = { nixpkgs, zalo-for-linux, ... }: { nixosConfigurations. = nixpkgs.lib.nixosSystem { modules = [ zalo-for-linux.nixosModules.default ./configuration.nix ]; }; }; } ``` ```nix # configuration.nix programs.zalo = { enable = true; # variant = "original"; # omit for default ZaDark variant }; ``` **Home Manager (`home.nix`):** ```nix programs.zalo.enable = true; ``` **Quick Try without installing:** ```bash nix run github:VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux ``` --- ### 3. Other Installation Methods
⚙️ Gear Lever (Desktop Integration) 1. Download the latest `.AppImage` from [**Releases**](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/releases). 2. Install **Gear Lever** from [Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/it.mijorus.gearlever). 3. Open Gear Lever $\rightarrow$ click **Open** $\rightarrow$ select the downloaded `.AppImage`. 4. Click **Move to the app menu** to integrate Zalo into your desktop application launcher. 5. Updates are detected automatically inside Gear Lever via the **Update** button.
📦 Manual AppImage Run Download the latest `.AppImage` from [**Releases**](https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux/releases), make it executable, and run: ```bash chmod +x Zalo-*.AppImage ./Zalo-*.AppImage ``` > 📞 **Voice & Video Calls Requirement**: Install audio utilities for native call support: > > - **Debian / Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3 libopus0 pulseaudio-utils` > - **Arch Linux**: `sudo pacman -S python opus pulseaudio` > - **Fedora / RHEL**: `sudo dnf install python3 opus pulseaudio-utils` > - **openSUSE**: `sudo zypper install python3 libopus0 pulseaudio-utils` > - **Gentoo**: `sudo emerge --ask dev-lang/python media-libs/opus media-sound/pulseaudio-daemon`
🛠️ Build from Source Prerequisites: Node.js 22+, npm, `7z` (`p7zip-full`), C++ & Rust toolchains. ```bash git clone https://github.com/VN-Linux-Family/zalo-for-linux.git cd zalo-for-linux git submodule update --init --recursive npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit npm run main ``` The compiled AppImage will be saved in `dist/`. For build pipeline details and environment variables, see [development.md](./docs/dev/development.md).
--- ## 📚 Documentation & Guides | Guide | Purpose | | :------------------------------------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [**Known Issues & Workarounds**](./docs/user/known-issues.md) | Symptom-to-fix lookup table, Ubuntu sandbox fix, and call troubleshooting. | | [**Feature Overview**](./docs/user/features.md) | Offline mode, system tray autostart, custom userscripts, and ZaDark theme. | | [**Architecture Specs**](./docs/dev/architecture.md) | Technical overview of Electron wrapping, patch pipeline, and native modules. | | [**Development Guide**](./docs/dev/development.md) | Setup instructions, debugging workflows, and local test commands. | | [**Patch Authoring Guide**](./docs/dev/patch-guide.md) | How to write, register, and maintain resilient JavaScript patches. | | [**CI/CD & Release Workflow**](./docs/dev/ci-workflow.md) | Upstream polling mechanism, release bot, Nix hash updates, and fork rules. | | [**Contributing Guidelines**](./CONTRIBUTING.md) | Pull request standards, commit conventions, and testing requirements. | --- ## ⚙️ How It Works This project is not a from-scratch rewrite of Zalo. It works by: 1. Downloading the official macOS `.dmg` file. 2. Using `7z` to extract the `app.asar` archive, which contains the main application logic written in JavaScript. 3. Removing incompatible native macOS files. 4. Wrapping the extracted application in a minimal, Linux-compatible Electron shell. 5. Using `electron-builder`, then `quick-sharun` to package everything into a single, portable `AppImage` file. For a deeper dive into the build pipeline and patching strategy, see [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](./docs/dev/architecture.md). For native addons (db-cross-v4, etc.), see [`native/addons/README.md`](./native/addons/README.md). For the native call engine, see [`native/engines/zcall/README.md`](./native/engines/zcall/README.md) ## 🐛 Troubleshooting & Debugging If you encounter issues or want to inspect the app's behavior, you can easily open Chrome Developer Tools (DevTools) using the following methods: - **Keyboard Shortcut**: Press `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `I` while the Zalo window is focused. - **Tray Menu**: Right-click the Zalo tray icon and select **"Toggle DevTools"**. ## Contributors Thanks goes to these wonderful people
